card.name: Start of a split drug or medical word
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that has been split up, right after a colon, a verb like discontinue, or a section heading. Often the start of a drug name or a word like adequate.

modes.label: Adequate after a heading
modes.description: The opening piece of the word adequate at the start of a sentence in a label section.

modes.label: Start of a drug name
modes.description: The first piece of a brand or generic drug name after a verb such as discontinue or use of.
modes.example: Discontinue<< Ang>>eliq pending examination if there is sudden

modes.label: Start of other long words
modes.description: The opening piece of a capitalised or technical word such as antagonists, carinii or deterioration.

card.plain: It marks the first chunk of a long word, often a drug name, that the model is still reading.
